name: GRIM
source:
Robbie is about to experience the worst day of his life. All at once, his world falls apart and he goes to seek solace at a place that he has fond memories of. There he meets Joe, who plans to just have a good time with Robbie, until...

[From [url=https://milo-wildcat.itch.io/grim-vn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
罗比即将经历他人生中最糟糕的一天。顷刻之间，他的整个世界分崩离析，只得前往一处承载着自己美好回忆的地方寻求慰藉。在那里，他遇见了乔——乔原本只打算和罗比痛快玩上一场，直到……
